text:
**Notice: Maple Street Repair Cafe Is Moving**

This Saturday, our repair cafe will meet at the Community Hall instead of the library. Volunteers, please arrive at 9:30 a.m. to help set up tables and tools. Visitors are welcome from 10:00 a.m. Bring your broken lamps, torn clothing, and wobbly chairs, and we'll fix them together. See you there!
task: Write a notice explaining that a fictional neighborhood repair cafe will move its Saturday session from the library to the community hall. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 and visitors at 10.
